title: Stock VICE parity: what changes for the tool surface
summary: Two-way gap analysis of capabilities lost, gained, and reimplemented when migrating from the custom x64sc -mcpserver to stock VICE's binary monitor.
notes: No frontmatter and no filename-convention signal. Competing signals: SPEC-flavored content (binary monitor command codes such as CPUHISTORY_GET 0x86, MEM_GET, RESOURCE_GET/SET 0x51/0x52, KEYBOARD_FEED 0x72) versus DOC-flavored structure (prose-heavy comparative analysis, no contracts, schemas, or normative requirements). Resolved to DOC because the command references are cited as evidence in a capability gap analysis rather than defined as implementation contracts; the document also contains no Decision/Consequences sections and no acceptance criteria. It is a decision-input analysis feeding docs/roadmap-stock-vice.md, so the synthesizer may want to treat its loss/gain findings as constraints on any future stock-VICE migration ADR.
